content.title: April Full Moon 2026: Tarot guidance and rituals for each zodiac sign | Astrology
content.text: The Full Moon on April 2, 2026, also known as the Pink Moon, is a time to slow down and check in with yourself. It is not just about manifesting what you want, but also about letting go of what no longer feels right. Think of it as an emotional reset; a chance to release, reflect, and move forward with a clearer mind.April Full Moon 2026: Tarot guidance and rituals for each zodiac sign (Freepik)Even if you do not believe in tarot or moon rituals, taking a few quiet moments for yourself can still feel calming and helpful. Sometimes, simple reflection is all we need to feel more focused and grounded. As tarot reader and crystal healer Kishori Sud from EnigmaTarotTribe says, the Full Moon is like a “cosmic clean-up moment.”ALSO READ: Ketu transit in Magha Nakshatra 2026: An astrologer breaks down its impact on your zodiac signHere’s a simple tarot message and easy ritual for each zodiac sign to help you make the most of this energy:Aries (March 21 – April 19)This Full Moon asks you to slow down and be patient.Tarot message: What am I rushing?Crystal: AmethystRitual: Sit quietly for 10 minutes, hold your crystal, and write down one thing you are forcing. Take a deep breath and let it go.Taurus (April 20 – May 20)It’s time to step out of your comfort zone.Tarot message: Where am I resisting change?Crystal: Green AventurineRitual: Clean your space and keep the crystal near your bed. Tell yourself you are open to new opportunities.Gemini (May 21 – June 20)Your mind may feel busy, clear the noise.Tarot message: What thought is draining me?Crystal: Clear QuartzRitual: Write down everything on your mind, then tear the paper. Let your thoughts go.Cancer (June 21 – July 22)Your emotions may feel stronger than usual, and that is okay.Tarot message: What am I holding onto?Crystal: MoonstoneRitual: Place your hand on your heart, hold your crystal, and allow yourself to feel freely.Leo (July 23 – August 22)Let go of needing others' approval.Tarot message: Where am I seeking validation?Crystal: Tiger’s EyeRitual: Stand
